primary_source_url: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx (Ministry of Labour & Employment, Cabinet Decisions)
primary_source_title: Union Cabinet Approval of Employment-Linked Incentive (ELI) Scheme — Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY)
issuing_authority: Union Cabinet / Ministry of Labour & Employment / EPFO
publication_date: Cabinet Resolution / Notification (Registration: Aug 1, 2025 to Jul 31, 2027; Horizon: FY 2025-26 to FY 2031-32)
document_identifier: PIB Press Release (Ministry of Labour & Employment) / MoL&E Scheme Guidelines

claim_checks.evidence_location: PIB Release — Cabinet Decisions Summary / MoL&E Financial Allocation Table
claim_checks.evidence_text_or_precise_reference: Official government sanctioned outlay is ₹99,446 Crore (not ₹1,07,000 Crore). Outlay spans FY 2025-26 to FY 2031-32, targeting 3.5 Crore total jobs (1.92 Crore first-time entrants under Part A incentive up to ₹15,000; Part B employer incentive up to ₹3,000/month).

contradiction_details: PROVEN NUMERICAL CONTRADICTION: Coaching note in CGB Mentors & Smartkeeda asserts a ₹1,07,000 Crore outlay based on unverified pre-Cabinet draft estimates. Official Cabinet sanction is ₹99,446 Crore. Unreconciled discrepancy: ₹7,554 Crore.
audit_notes: QUARANTINED. Direct primary document retrieved. Factual numerical inflation in coaching source.
